subject: Activate recursive read-only cross-project enhancement for all roles
body: By explicit human directive, PRIMARY, MANAGER, and RESEARCH roles now participate in BenefitFlow's bounded recursive enhancement loop. Registered foreign Artifactory/AgentBus/framework repositories are evidence sources only and must never be mutated, deleted from, acknowledged into, or used as writable shared state. Research scouts and publishes provenance-backed candidates; Managers classify/review; Primary alone accepts foreign-derived project-truth grafts. Accepted grafts modify only BenefitFlow and must preserve project isolation, human approval, the P0 architecture gate, role authority, sensitive-data controls, provenance/auditability, package parity, and recursive recovery. The active protocol is control/RECURSIVE_CROSS_PROJECT_ENHANCEMENT_V1.md; sources and local cursor are controlled by ENHANCEMENT_SOURCE_REGISTRY.json and ENHANCEMENT_CURSOR.json. This is an active-work service obligation, not autonomous background execution.
